name: Greensleeves
description: Gull's sister who cannot talk at first because of the Woods' magic and is revealed to be a wizard.

description_citations.text: "Whispering Woods (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.quote: Greensleeves was reborn as the Maro-Sorcerer of the Whispering Woods

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth attacks Gull and Greensleeves believing they were the kidnappers, then is calmed and promises never to abandon his family.
timeline.quote: Garth admitted the wrongness of his ways

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Garth gives his spell satchel to Greensleeves and offers his knowledge of Dominaria to bring Gull's army home.
timeline.quote: giving up his spells' satchel to Greensleeves

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves becomes a planeswalker and sacrifices her spark to heal Lat-Nam.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves and her party come to Lat-Nam in 4077 AR to uncover the secrets of the Stone Brain, battling and befriending its guardians.
timeline.quote: After a battle, Greensleeves befriended the guardians and led an excavation

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "Battle of Lat-Nam". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves kills Haakon after he hits her brother, traps the wizards and absorbs a Force of Nature, nearly losing herself until Kwam restores her sanity.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves, in a fit of grief and rage, killed Haakon

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "Battle of Lat-Nam". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves pours her mana into Lat-Nam, purging its corruption and turning it into a paradise at the cost of her planeswalker powers; she becomes High Wizard of the Domains.
timeline.quote: This act cost her planeswalker powers , but secured her victory

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "Battle of Lat-Nam". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Haakon is defeated and his fortress destroyed by the army of Gull and Greensleeves.
timeline.quote: until he was defeated and his fortress destroyed by Gull and Greensleeves ' army

citation.text: "Badlands", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gull and Greensleeves refuse to leave; Sparrow Hawk has vanished.
timeline.quote: Their younger brother, Sparrow Hawk , had vanished in the destruction

citation.text: "Battle of White Ridge", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves meets Chaney in northern Aerona and is taught to harness mana and about planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Chaney taught Greensleeves how to harness mana

citation.text: "Chaney", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves trains for about five years while only days pass outside, emerging years older and a more skilled wizard and druid.
timeline.quote: Despite training for around five years, only a few days passed.

citation.text: "Chaney", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chaney dies of mortality in 4074 AR and her life force is absorbed by Greensleeves.

citation.text: "Chaney", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chaney returns as a shade urging Greensleeves to make the final sacrifice, then passes on after Greensleeves dons the Stone Brain.
timeline.quote: Three years later, Chaney returned as a shade

citation.text: "Chaney", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gull falls in love with Lily after joining Towser's caravan.
timeline.quote: Gull fell in love with Lily

citation.text: "Lily", section "Working for Towser". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Towser kidnaps the girls and teleports Gull away; Lily summons him back and Towser is defeated.
timeline.quote: Lily discovered her magical ability to summon Gull back.

citation.text: "Lily", section "Working for Towser". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Norreen becomes Gull's lover and army commander, then attempts suicide, is tortured and saved by Lily and Gull.

citation.text: "Norreen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: White Ridge is destroyed during a wizard's duel and Sparrow Hawk is separated from his family.

citation.text: "Sparrow Hawk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gull and Greensleeves form an army and liberate almost all of North Aerona.
timeline.quote: liberated almost all of North Aerona from rampaging wizards

citation.text: "Sparrow Hawk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The wizards, aided by the Keldon Warlord, attack the army; Gull is almost killed before Greensleeves teleports him away.

citation.text: "Sparrow Hawk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Haakon's fireball drives Greensleeves mad with grief and she becomes a godlike being.

citation.text: "Sparrow Hawk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kwam brings Greensleeves to her senses; she pours her mana into Lat-Nam, curing it and sacrificing her planeswalker powers.
timeline.quote: in the process sacrificing her planeswalker powers

citation.text: "Sparrow Hawk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves is declared High Wizard of the Domains; she and her brothers then vanish from history.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers.

citation.text: "Sparrow Hawk", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Towser plans to kill Greensleeves by stealing and copying her Nova Pentacle.
timeline.quote: he planned to kill her by stealing and copying her Nova Pentacle

citation.text: "Towser", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Greensleeves defeats him at the Battle of Lat-Nam, she uses the Stone Brain to take away his ability to do magic.

citation.text: "Towser", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leechnip summons a mana construct of Ur-Drago in Towser's attack on Greensleeves' Grove; Greensleeves banishes it to the Abyss at heavy cost.

citation.text: "Ur-Drago", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
